cohort_ledger.individualization_policy: Four rank cohorts only; no mounted-scout or officer manpower strata.

officer_establishment.representation_rule: Army and disciple-rank commanders/deputies are full characters outside fighting strength. Embedded 1,000/500 commanders are conserved members of their disciple rank; 100-man and below remain aggregate unless salient.

personnel_representation: cohort-first four-tier House Tang military force; internal 1,000/500 officers are represented conserved troops; routine 100-man command remains aggregate.

capacity_policy.rule: No fixed personnel cap. Sword Manor grows only through conserved applicants, internal selection/training, equipment, officers, housing, food, medical support, administration, and physical training capacity. It trains its own force only and has no outsider instructional enrollment.

organization_rule: Sword Manor is a permanent House Tang troop-house force. Its members remain in persistent formations in peace and war; training occurs inside the force. Deployment changes command attachment/location, not whether the force exists.
